mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_file (user_id, parent_id, name, path, size, mime_type, extension, file_hash, is_directory, object_name, status) VALUES (#{userId}, #{parentId}, #{name}, #{path}, #{size}, #{mimeType}, #{extension}, #{fileHash}, #{isDirectory}, #{objectName}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM t_file WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND parent_id = #{parentId} AND status = 1
SELECT * FROM t_file WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND path = #{path} AND status = 1
mapper.update: UPDATE t_file SET name = #{name}, path = #{path}, size = #{size}, mime_type = #{mimeType}, extension = #{extension}, file_hash = #{fileHash}, is_directory = #{isDirectory}, object_name = #{objectName}, status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE t_file SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM t_file ORDER BY created_at DESC
